game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto, a grotto of glowing crystals: the spelunker must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.

player_objective: Archive variation 10: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Ritchie and Bell Labs.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: dungeon_clear drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 4: Ritchie and Bell Labs
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
